# Local fonts

Inter 4.1: https://github.com/rsms/inter/tree/v4.1/docs/font-files

Roboto: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/1c627bfa375fc51cf86fabeca4f6e08a95f0aa5c/ofl/roboto

Unmodified variable fonts, distributed under SIL Open Font License 1.1; licenses are included. Inter is used on desktop/tablet, Roboto at phone widths (up to 46rem). All requests stay on the local app.
